rules: GEO-1 is not implemented by this packet.
No existing spatial implementation is restored, redesigned, deleted, consolidated, or migrated by GEO-0.
Demo/static geography must not become institutional reporting authority without Evidence, Truth, Metric Registry, Reporting, and publication approval.

phases.name: Recovery and Forensics
phases.purpose: Inventory spatial assets, implementations, historical recovery folders, authority boundaries, and gaps.

phases.name: Canonical Spatial Authority Charter
phases.purpose: Define ownership, allowed data classes, spatial source authority, and non-authoritative demo boundaries.

phases.name: Spatial Asset and Source Registry
phases.purpose: Canonicalize asset/source metadata without moving assets.

phases.name: Spatial Data Contracts
phases.purpose: Define county, jurisdiction, geometry, feature, coordinate, and provenance contracts.

phases.name: Map Runtime Boundary
phases.purpose: Decide runtime engines and route-level loading rules across d3/SVG, Globe, Mapbox, MapLibre, and Three.

phases.name: Spatial Truth and Reporting Boundary
phases.purpose: Bind spatial claims to Evidence, Truth, Metric Registry, Reporting, and public disclosure only where approved.

phases.name: CivicSure / GPA Jurisdiction Integration
phases.purpose: Connect jurisdiction/source-scope models to spatial read surfaces without turning maps into authority.

phases.name: User Experience and Accessibility Acceptance
phases.purpose: Validate spatial views for accessible alternatives, keyboard behavior, text equivalents, and responsive framing.

phases.name: Migration and Preservation Plan
phases.purpose: Decide what to preserve, archive, leave untouched, or replace later.

phases.name: Implementation Readiness Gate
phases.purpose: Confirm all dependencies, risks, owners, tests, and rollback are ready before implementation.

phases.name: Final Spatial Intelligence Acceptance
phases.purpose: Certify spatial intelligence implementation against contracts and repository evidence.
